name: Limitless Nexus
description: Nexus build/test repository for Limitless providers. Anime providers prefer MAL/Jikan, supplement sparse MAL title sets with AniList, and fall back to TMDB/IMDb when anime metadata services are unavailable; proven changes are promoted to the main branch after validation.

scrapers.name: Re:ANIME
scrapers.description: Anime provider using the shared Nexus anime identity layer. MAL/Jikan is preferred first, AniList supplements sparse/failed MAL title sets, and strict TMDB/IMDb-backed Re:ANIME catalog matching remains available when anime metadata services fail. Season 0 entries resolve as separate Re:ANIME special/OVA records by TMDB special-episode title. Live /api/flix availability overrides stale special catalog flags, and confirmed Re:ANIME catalog matches with no playable episode servers return the No Episode on Source information row instead of disappearing.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus

scrapers.name: WCO
scrapers.description: WCO production provider with wcostream.tv → wcoflix.tv → wcoforever.net fallback coverage, premium/mirror support, Season 0/special handling, strict series and episode ownership checks, and the separately gated Power Rangers resolver. Anime prefers MAL/Jikan, supplements sparse MAL title sets with AniList, then falls back to TMDB aliases. Anime episode ownership accepts strong multi-token anime aliases for legitimate dub/sub slug differences, WCO continues across strong anime series candidates until both available Dub and Sub branches are collected, and trusted anime aliases are also tried as direct /anime/<slug>/ candidates when WCO search omits an otherwise valid series page. Non-anime keeps strict page-slug ownership and bypasses anime databases entirely.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus WCO production merge

scrapers.name: AsiaFlix
scrapers.description: Experimental Asian drama/show provider using AsiaFlix's current v1 JSON API for title search, detail/episode lookup, and server resolution. Matches Nuvio TMDB/IMDb metadata against primary and alternate titles, preserves original-audio language labels, probes HLS quality where available, and intentionally refuses TV seasons above Season 1 until a safe season-title mapping is validated.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus port based on current Yuzono/Keiyoushi AsiaFlix and CSX provider behavior

scrapers.name: Tubi
scrapers.description: Tubi playback provider using Tubi's current anonymous-device bearer-token flow, nested season/episode mapping, and clear HLS playback. Anime titles use shared MAL/Jikan-first identity aliases, with AniList supplementing sparse MAL title sets before TMDB/IMDb fallback; non-anime titles remain on the original TMDB/IMDb matching path. Strict anime candidate scoring prevents generic partial-title false positives. Keeps the top two video quality levels with up to two distinct manifests per quality and skips DRM-only titles.
scrapers.author: Limitless Nexus Tubi provider

scrapers.name: AnikotoTV
scrapers.description: AnikotoTV with standardized DUB/SOFTSUB/DUB+SUBS output labels based on the provider's existing selectable caption tracks.
scrapers.author: piratezoro9
